summary: Strive, Inc. filed a routine Item 8.01 8-K announcing bitcoin treasury updates for the September 14-18, 2026 period. The Company purchased 1,355 bitcoin at an average price of approximately $79,475 per bitcoin, inclusive of fees, raising holdings to 26,355 bitcoin. Cash rose to $229.6 million, STRC preferred holdings remained 505,000 shares at $49.7 million fair value, and SATA preferred shares grew to 11,184,160. No M&A, tender, activist, or strategic-review event is present; this is ordinary treasury disclosure without deal terms. Key watch: continued bitcoin accumulation and preferred issuance dilution.
